name: Dynamic-Quiz-Platform
description: Master your knowledge across 20+ categories with our vast question bank. An interactive, high-performance quiz experience with randomized challenges.

paragraphs: A modern, high-performance quiz application built with React and Vite that leverages the OpenTDB API to deliver customizable, real-time examinations across 20+ knowledge domains. Featuring automated timers, audio-tactile feedback, and comprehensive review capabilities for an enhanced learning experience.
features: 20+ Knowledge Domains: Generate localized tests across diverse categories including Science, History, Geography, Entertainment, Sports, and more
3 Difficulty Levels: Easy, Medium, and Hard options to match user expertise
2 Question Types: Multiple Choice and True/False formats
Dynamic Question Count: User-selectable quiz length for flexible learning sessions
OpenTDB API Integration: Real-time question fetching from the Open Trivia Database
